title: Prioritise customer markets, win on service and cost, then expand

investment_gate: New storage follows secured incremental flows and a gap in usable capacity; the illustrative 5.5 bn litres does not establish a commitment.
nigel_action: Choose the first customer/product and acceptable cost. Confirm the service proposition and commercial access.
manish_action: Build a customer-by-route evidence table: litres, cost, capacity, rights, timing and owner. Mark each gate passed, failed or unassessed.
expiry_trigger: Replace priority hypotheses when customer flows, route costs and usable capacity are reviewed. Timing is conditional, not a calendar commitment.
